structured.feedback: Meets the core requirements: Markdown headings, roughly 200 words, separate features and benefits sections, a call to action, no links, no invented quotes, and no mention of the product's weaknesses. Minor issues only: some generic phrasing ("versatile, cost-effective," "looking their best") and the "Trusted by Shoppers" section leans on rating stats, but nothing blocks shipping.
